caption: The drawing depicts a figurine featuring a young person and a dog mounted on a rectangular platform. The person is seated on the left side, wearing a red shirt with a black bow, a matching red skirt with yellow trim, black shoes, and a light blue hat with a yellow band. The skin tone is pale, and the hair is a light brownish-blonde. The person's left arm rests on their lap while the right arm is bent and raised with the hand open near the dog's face. The dog, which is positioned on the right and facing the person, is medium-to-large in size, colored in shades of brown with a lighter-colored snout and paws. The dog wears a green collar and is sitting upright on its hind legs, with its right front paw placed on the edge of the platform. The rectangular platform is painted mostly dark brown with red, yellow, and green detailing, and the words “SPEAKING DOG” are prominently shown in large letters on the front. The background of the image is blank and off-white.
title: Toy: Speaking Dog Bank
